'''Andrew Varston''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 4th at [[September 2000 Smyrna tournament]] on 23 September 2000, according to James McNash's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1261">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-23-smryna-georgia-9-23-00d1261/ smryna-georgia-9-23-00], DeckTech (James "kmcnash" McNash, 23 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-23-smryna-georgia-9-23-00d1261/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
